summary: New pinned compatibility set startup-triage-optout (OpenClaw 2026.9.6 and 2026.10.9): one guard at the head of triageAfterFailure returns before any triage process, managed-handoff claim, embedded repair turn or external coding agent when a gateway-startup failure meets OPENCLAW_STARTUP_TRIAGE=off. gateway-start.sh exports the variable only after the set is applied and verified; runtime-sync checks and applies it, deploy rollback undoes it.
reason: A failed Gateway start makes OpenClaw (installed 2026.9.6 and candidate 2026.10.9) start an unsupervised repair turn with the configured model or claude -p (seen in the 01/11 rehearsal). Upstream has no dedicated setting; the existing guards carry other meanings and are not repurposed (decision after PR #504).
